'''Superdm32''' is a significantly large map, designed for more than 16 players in FFA or 8on8 / 10on10. It is a merge of the classical maps DM2, DM3 and DM4. Each of the 3 map sections has 2 physical passages, which leads to the other parts of the sections (DM2 has 1 passage to DM3, and 1 to DM4, and so on).

Map is available on qw.foppa.dk:27501
